build_ivf_sq_index: build an IVF scalar quantizer index with HNSW flat quantizer and random rotation pre-transform
create_hnsw_quantizer: create an HNSW flat index to use as a quantizer for IVF scalar quantizer
create_random_rotation: create a random rotation matrix and apply it to centroid vectors for index training
test_fvecs_mmap: test the fvecs_mmap function to memory-map a float vector file and return a numpy array
test_ivecs_mmap: test the ivecs_mmap function to memory-map an integer vector file and return a numpy array
